entities.summary: Bogen Chapel is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Evenes Municipality in Nordland county, Norway. It is located in the village of Bogen. It is one of two churches in the Evenes parish which is part of the Ofoten prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Sør-Hålogaland. The white, wooden church was built in a long church style in 1920 using plans drawn up by the architect Bjarne Romsloe. The chapel seats about 260 people.
